item.title: World's First Wind-Powered Underwater Datacenter Operates in China
item.description:
The world’s first wind-powered underwater datacentre has begun operations off the coast of Shanghai. This 24-megawatt project aims to use less power and water than land-based equivalents. It is part of China's effort to find sustainable energy solutions for its artificial intelligence boom.
